summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing of BitsNdBricks Phase-1 responsive UI + admin bulk-ops + pending badge. All 9 acceptance items PASS. No horizontal overflow at 320/390/768 for /, /jobs, /tenders, /submit, and job & tender detail pages. Mobile hamburger (data-testid mobile-menu-button) shows only at <=640px and reveals mobile-nav-jobs/tenders/submit which navigate correctly; desktop inline nav is visible at >=1024px and hamburger is hidden. Submit form is single-column at 390px and 2-col paired (Title|Company, Collar|Trade, State|City, LastDate|ApplicantContact) at 1024px; submitting a Job with only a title yields submit-success. Tender detail on mobile reflows to Title -> 'Tender Information' key-info card (top=350) BEFORE 'Tender Description' (top=1106); tender-status pill shows text 'Expired' (not color-only). Admin login: wrong password stays on gate, 'Hitchhiker@360' logs in and shows admin-create-button. admin-pending-badge shows '2 pending', clicking switches to Inbox tab. Bulk approve on BNB-J-2026-00010 removed it from inbox and badge decreased 2->1. Bulk reject on BNB-T-2026-00009 removed it and badge disappeared (0). Regression: single-row admin-publish/verify/reject/delete/submitter buttons still present; Jobs (8 rows) and Tenders (8 rows) tabs list correctly. /jobs and /tenders State filter dropdowns are populated only from listings that actually exist (Kerala/MP/Maharashtra/Telangana for jobs; KA/MH/RJ/TN/TG/UP for tenders).

issues: Radix Dialog console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. The Sheet used for the mobile menu should include a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle + SheetDescription for accessibility. Purely a11y warning; no functional impact.

action_items: Optional a11y fix: add a VisuallyHidden SheetTitle (and SheetDescription) inside /app/frontend/src/components/Header.jsx SheetContent to eliminate Radix Dialog console warnings.

Minor UX: on first admin login, admin-pending-badge appears only after refreshCounts() completes (2-3s). Consider showing a subdued placeholder or firing refreshCounts synchronously with initial load(); non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx uses window.confirm() for the single-row delete guard — fine for internal tool but not consistent with the shadcn dialog patterns used elsewhere; also blocks Playwright/keyboard-only users.

bulkAction fires Promise.all of PATCHes with no per-item error handling; if one PATCH 4xx/5xx's, toast.success is still shown and the failure is swallowed. Recommend Promise.allSettled + partial-success toast.
In Header.jsx the mobile Sheet has no SheetTitle/SheetDescription => Radix a11y warnings on every mobile menu open (visible in console).

admin-pending-badge count is fetched separately via refreshCounts()  which duplicates two /api/admin/{jobs,tenders}?status=pending calls also made by load() when kind==='inbox'. A single count endpoint or shared state would remove the duplicate round-trip and eliminate the visible ~2s delay before the badge appears on login.
